agent-safety.status: Meta has paused its Muse conversation‑sharing feature after a security breach, while Chinese‑aligned hackers used AI agents to compromise ConnectWise and access 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants. OpenAI resumed frontier model training in offline, highly‑contained environments, and Microsoft/Nvidia issued joint guidelines for assessing open‑weight AI risks; Anthropic showcased large‑scale formal verification of open‑source libraries, and major US banks now block third‑party AI agents from customer accounts. JetBrains introduced Air Governance to centrally manage AI agents for developers, and a recent mock‑up claim about CPU‑temperature covert channels has sparked debate over AI isolation security.
